long_biography.plain_text:
International expansion turned Palladium Hotel Group from an island hotel business into the defining enterprise of Abel Matutes y Juan. After developing properties across the Balearic and Canary Islands, the company entered the Caribbean in the early 1990s, then grouped its hotels under the Fiesta name before adopting Palladium.

Matutes has handed operational leadership to the next generation while remaining chairman of the board. As honorary president of the foundation he created in 1978, he is associated with programmes in education, social welfare, environmental work, culture and sport, especially in Ibiza and Formentera. Abel Matutes Prats now leads the hotel group, while Carmen Matutes Juan chairs the foundation.

Palladium's own history identifies Abel Matutes Juan as founder of the hotel chain and the first Ibiza hotels as the family's first hospitality venture. Palladium's current team page distinguishes Abel Matutes Juan as chairman of the board, Abel Matutes Prats as president and Carmen Matutes as deputy chief executive. The foundation separately lists Carmen Matutes Juan as board chair and the elder Matutes as honorary president. These role distinctions prevent conflation among family members.
